name: Miskovice
text: Miskovice is a municipality and village in Kutná Hora District in the Central Bohemian Region of the Czech Republic. It has about 1,200 inhabitants.

depictions.name: miskowitz
depictions.text: (Czech: Miskovice) is a village located in the central part of the map on the main road west of Kuttenberg, southwest of Pschitoky and northwest of Bylany.
